Claim: "8-12 in of water", arrow at fire hydrant, 140-144 Bay Ave block
(Fresh restaurant + the #140 storefront visible) — DOWNTOWN end of Bay
Ave, different drainage than the 342 Bay catchment. Posted ~noon
2026-08-03 during the Flash Flood Warning; Joe collects flood photos at
joe@cupajoe.live.

PROVENANCE / METADATA VERDICT (checked 2026-08-03): no EXIF, no XMP, no
embedded dates; only Facebook's FBMD processing fingerprint survives —
the file is a FB re-encode of a composite graphic (banner text added),
so capture date CANNOT be verified from the file. Chain: camera original
(unseen) -> Highlands OEM -> Martucci composite -> Facebook re-encode ->
saved by user's wife. In-scene evidence (active rain pocking the
floodwater, summer foliage, dining tents/planters out, holiday bunting,
post context = that morning's warning) supports same-day capture but
does not prove it. A verified original would need Joe/OEM directly.
